subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers fail closed on every legacy ownerless session row once ownership is preserved across normal lifecycle operations?
rationale: Exact equality closes the cross-plugin gap, but it intentionally revokes plugin-runtime access to previously persisted ownerless rows and repository policy reserves that compatibility and security boundary for an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Fail closed with continuity
options.body: Preserve ownership through reset and reject genuinely legacy ownerless rows, leaving their management to operators or non-plugin clients.

options.title: Provide trusted migration
options.body: Add an operator-controlled doctor or migration flow that assigns verified owners before enforcing exact equality.

options.title: Retain temporary compatibility
options.body: Allow plugin access to ownerless rows during a transition, accepting ambiguous adoption and weaker cross-plugin isolation.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with continuity
recommendation.body: Preserve ownership through reset and reject genuinely legacy ownerless rows, leaving their management to operators or non-plugin clients.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice changes the cross-plugin authorization and upgrade boundary rather than merely implementation mechanics.
